before:
- name: Resolve points read endpoint
        if: env.PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_ENABLED == 'true' || inputs.test_scope == 'points-smoke'
        env:
          LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node - <<'JS'
          const fs = require('fs');
          const url = new URL(process.env.LOGIN_ENDPOINT);
          if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !url.pathname.endsWith('/rest/v1/test-login')) throw new Error('Unexpected login endpoint');
          url.pathname = url.pathname.replace('/rest/', '/read/').replace('test-login', 'pwappy-points');
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, 'PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_READ_ENDPOINT=' + (process.env.PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_READ_ENDPOINT || url.href) + '\n');
          JS

      - name: Check point preparation client
        run: node --test tests/tools/test-point-preparation.test.mjs

      - name: Run Normal E2E Tests
        id: run_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Schedule and omitted manual inputs use the same bounded normal defaults.
          WORKERS=1
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            WORKERS="${TEST_WORKERS:-1}"
          fi

          if [ "${{ inputs.test_scope }}" = "points-smoke" ]; then
            case "${{ matrix.browser }}" in
              chromium) BC=c ;; mobile-chrome) BC=a ;; webkit) BC=s ;; mobile-safari) BC=i ;;
              *) echo "Unsupported smoke browser"; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            case "${{ matrix.os }}" in
              ubuntu-latest) OC=u ;; windows-latest) OC=w ;; macos-latest) OC=m ;;
              *) echo "Unsupported smoke OS"; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            export PWAPPY_SMOKE_IDENT="pw${OC}${BC}998"
            node tests/tools/points-smoke.mjs
            exit $?
          fi

          echo "Running tests on $OS_NAME with workers: $WORKERS"
          RETRIES="${TEST_RETRIES:-0}"
          if ! [[ "$RETRIES" =~ ^[0-5]$ ]]; then
            echo "retries must be between 0 and 5"
            exit 1
          fi
          case "${TEST_SCOPE:-all}" in
            all) TEST_ARGS=(tests/specs/normal) ;;
            editor-regression)
              TEST_ARGS=(tests/specs/normal/editor-events-build.spec.ts tests/specs/normal/editor-property-parsing-build.spec.ts
                --grep 'DOMContentLoaded|loadイベント|ライフサイクルイベント|グローバルなイベント委譲|JSDocの@fires') ;;
            quick-property-regression)
              TEST_ARGS=(tests/specs/normal/editor-quick-property-editor.spec.ts) ;;
            style-ownership-regression)
              TEST_ARGS=(tests/specs/normal/editor-style-ownership.spec.ts) ;;
            *) echo "::error::Unsupported normal test scope"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          # Safariで入力処理自体が停止するため、ホスト負荷を記録する（テスト条件は維持）。
          if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            sysctl hw.memsize hw.ncpu
            E2E_RESOURCE_LOG="$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e-resources.log"
            (
              while true; do
                date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
                uptime
                vm_stat || true
                # commは実行ファイル名のみ。引数や環境変数は出力しない。
                ps -axo pid,ppid,%cpu,rss,comm | sort -k3 -nr | sed -n '1,12p' || true
                sleep 30
              done
            ) > "$E2E_RESOURCE_LOG" 2>&1 &
            E2E_MONITOR_PID=$!
            # Credential-free static GET timings only; no test/retry decisions.
            E2E_TRANSPORT_LOG="$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e-transport.log"
            node scripts/transport-sampler.mjs > "$E2E_TRANSPORT_LOG" 2>/dev/null &
            E2E_TRANSPORT_PID=$!
            finish_e2e_diagnostics() {
              e2e_status=$?
              trap - EXIT
              kill "$E2E_MONITOR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
              if jobs -pr | grep -Fxq -- "$E2E_TRANSPORT_PID"; then
                kill "$E2E_TRANSPORT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
              fi
              wait "$E2E_MONITOR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
              wait "$E2E_TRANSPORT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "::group::macOS runner resource samples"
              cat "$E2E_RESOURCE_LOG" || true
              echo "::endgroup::"
              echo "::group::macOS static transport samples"
              cat "$E2E_TRANSPORT_LOG" || true
              echo "::endgroup::"
              exit "$e2e_status"
            }
            trap finish_e2e_diagnostics EXIT
          fi
          npx playwright test "${TEST_ARGS[@]}" --project=${{ matrix.browser }} --reporter=line --workers="$WORKERS" --retries="$RETRIES"
          echo "EXIT_CODE=$?" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          TEST_SCOPE: ${{ inputs.test_scope || 'all' }}
          TEST_RETRIES: ${{ inputs.retries || '0' }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          TEST_WORKERS: ${{ github.event.inputs.workers }}
          TEST_RUN_SUFFIX: ${{ env.OS_SHORT_NAME }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_USER_PREFIX: "pwusr"
          PWAPPY_LOGIN: "1"
          TEST_GEMINI_API_KEY: "AIza_TEST_ONLY_WEBMCP"

      # テスト終了直後に、このランナー(マシン)が汚したワーカーセッションをその場で即座に自活掃除します
      - name: Run Local Cleanup on Finish
        timeout-minutes: 5
        if: always() && inputs.test_scope != 'points-smoke'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          OS_CODE_CHAR="l"
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "ubuntu-latest" ]; then OS_CODE_CHAR="u"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "windows-latest" ]; then OS_CODE_CHAR="w"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "macos-latest" ]; then OS_CODE_CHAR="m"; fi

          BROWSER_CODE="c"
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "firefox" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="f"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "webkit" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="s"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "mobile-chrome" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="a"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "mobile-safari" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="i"; fi

          # ローカルで作成された可能性のあるワーカー番号(0〜3)を走査して確実に掃除
          for worker in 0 1 2 3; do
            export PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_PHASE="cleanup"
            export TEST_WORKER_INDEX="$worker"
            export PWAPPY_TEST_CLEANUP_BROWSER_CODE="$BROWSER_CODE"
            export TEST_RUN_SUFFIX="${{ env.OS_SHORT_NAME }}"
            
            SESSION_FILE=".auth/user-${OS_CODE_CHAR}-${BROWSER_CODE}-${worker}.json"
            
            if [ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ] && [ "$(cat "$SESSION_FILE" | tr -d ' ')" != "{}" ]; then
              echo "=== Cleaning up local account: OS[${{ matrix.os }}] Browser[${{ matrix.browser }}] Worker[$worker] ==="
              npx playwright test tests/tools/a0-cleanup-all-apps.spec.ts --project=${{ matrix.browser }} --output=test-results-cleanup
            fi
          done
        env:
          PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE }}
          PWAPPY_LOGIN: "1"
          TEST_GEMINI_API_KEY: "AIza_TEST_ONLY_WEBMCP"

- name: Resolve points read endpoint
        if: env.PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_ENABLED == 'true' || inputs.test_scope == 'points-smoke'
        env:
          LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node - <<'JS'
          const fs = require('fs');
          const url = new URL(process.env.LOGIN_ENDPOINT);
          if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !url.pathname.endsWith('/rest/v1/test-login')) throw new Error('Unexpected login endpoint');
          url.pathname = url.pathname.replace('/rest/', '/read/').replace('test-login', 'pwappy-points');
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, 'PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_READ_ENDPOINT=' + (process.env.PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_READ_ENDPOINT || url.href) + '\n');
          JS

      - name: Check point preparation client
        run: node --test tests/tools/test-point-preparation.test.mjs

      - name: Protect existing Premium credentials
        id: premium_key_preflight
        shell: bash
        run: node scripts/preflight-main-premium.mjs
        env:
          PWAPPY_PREFLIGHT_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.browser }}
          PWAPPY_PREFLIGHT_OS: ${{ matrix.os }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_ACCOUNT_INDEX: "0"
          PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE }}

      - name: Run Premium E2E Tests
        id: run_tests
        if: steps.premium_key_preflight.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        # 最も安定した直列実行(1ワーカー)で実行。
        run: |
          RETRIES="${TEST_RETRIES:-0}"
          if ! [[ "$RETRIES" =~ ^[0-5]$ ]]; then
            echo "retries must be between 0 and 5"
            exit 1
          fi
          npx playwright test tests/specs/premium --project=${{ matrix.browser }} --reporter=line --workers=1 --retries="$RETRIES"
          echo "EXIT_CODE=$?" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          TEST_RETRIES: ${{ inputs.retries || '0' }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_ACCOUNT_INDEX: "0"
          TEST_RUN_SUFFIX: ${{ env.OS_SHORT_NAME }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_USER_PREFIX: "pwusr"
          PWAPPY_LOGIN: "1"
          TEST_GEMINI_API_KEY: "AIza_TEST_ONLY_WEBMCP"

      # テスト終了直後に、このランナー(マシン)が汚したワーカーセッションをその場で即座に自活掃除します
      - name: Run Local Cleanup on Finish
        timeout-minutes: 5
        if: always() && steps.premium_key_preflight.outcome == 'success' && steps.run_tests.outcome != 'skipped' && inputs.test_scope != 'points-smoke'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          OS_CODE_CHAR="l"
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "ubuntu-latest" ]; then OS_CODE_CHAR="u"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "windows-latest" ]; then OS_CODE_CHAR="w"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "macos-latest" ]; then OS_CODE_CHAR="m"; fi

          BROWSER_CODE="c"
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "firefox" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="f"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "webkit" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="s"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "mobile-chrome" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="a"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.browser }}" = "mobile-safari" ]; then BROWSER_CODE="i"; fi

          # ローカルで作成された可能性のあるワーカー番号(0〜3)を走査して確実に掃除
          for worker in 0 1 2 3; do
            export PWAPPY_TEST_POINTS_PHASE="cleanup"
            export TEST_WORKER_INDEX="$worker"
            export PWAPPY_TEST_CLEANUP_BROWSER_CODE="$BROWSER_CODE"
            export TEST_RUN_SUFFIX="${{ env.OS_SHORT_NAME }}"
            
            SESSION_FILE=".auth/user-${OS_CODE_CHAR}-${BROWSER_CODE}-${worker}.json"
            
            if [ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ] && [ "$(cat "$SESSION_FILE" | tr -d ' ')" != "{}" ]; then
              echo "=== Cleaning up local account: OS[${{ matrix.os }}] Browser[${{ matrix.browser }}] Worker[$worker] ==="
              npx playwright test tests/tools/a0-cleanup-all-apps.spec.ts --project=${{ matrix.browser }} --output=test-results-cleanup
            fi
          done
        env:
          PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_BASE_URL }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_ENDPOINT }}
          PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE: ${{ secrets.PWAPPY_TEST_LOGIN_PASSCODE }}
          PWAPPY_LOGIN: "1"
          TEST_GEMINI_API_KEY: "AIza_TEST_ONLY_WEBMCP"

- name: Cache Playwright browsers
        if: inputs.test_scope != 'points-smoke'
        id: cache-playwright-browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH }}
          key: ${{ env.CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}-${{ steps.get-date.outputs.date }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}-

      # キャッシュから復元された不要なロックファイルを事前に強制削除してハングを防ぐ
      - name: Remove stale Playwright locks
        if: inputs.test_scope != 'points-smoke'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -d "${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH }}" ]; then
            echo "Checking for stale locks in ${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH }}..."
            rm -rf "${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH }}/__dirlock"
            find "${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH }}" -name "__dirlock" -exec rm -rf {} + || true
          fi

      - name: Install Playwright system dependencies
        if: inputs.test_scope != 'points-smoke' && steps.cache-playwright-browsers.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install-deps ${{ matrix.binary }}
        env:
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        if: inputs.test_scope != 'points-smoke' && steps.cache-playwright-browsers.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install ${{ matrix.binary }}
        env:
          DEBUG: pw:*
